name: Files.com MCP
description: Lets local MCP clients upload, download, move and share files, manage users and read audit logs on a Files.com site through a Python stdio server.

skills.name: Upload and Download Files
skills.description: Uploads and downloads files between your machine and Files.com, optionally limited to one local root directory.

skills.name: Manage Files and Folders
skills.description: Creates folders and copies, moves, deletes, zips, unzips or GPG-encrypts files and folders on your Files.com site.

skills.name: Create Share Links
skills.description: Creates and updates share links with recipients and notifications, and lists who downloaded or registered for them.

skills.name: Manage Users and Groups
skills.description: Creates, updates and deletes users, groups and folder permissions on the site under your API key's permissions.

skills.name: Read Audit Logs
skills.description: Lists action, login, SFTP, FTP, automation and API request logs plus per-file, folder and user history.
